presets.name: Just like you
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: She follows your voice exactly: your rhythm, your ups and downs. Good for talking.

presets.name: Pop singer
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: A bright, doubled lead: what you say becomes a tune in a major key.

presets.name: Whisper
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Half voiced, close to the mic, soft as a secret.

presets.name: Metal scream
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Pressed, distorted and fried, in a minor key. Every line is a scream.

presets.name: Robot
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Flat machine notes, ring-modulated and crushed. No bends, no vibrato.

presets.name: Diva
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: An opera voice: a wide minor melody, a huge slow vibrato, a hall.

presets.name: Choir
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Many voices in a big room: chorused, doubled, an octave above.

presets.name: Lo-fi radio
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: An old telephone speaker: narrow, crunchy, a little hiss.

presets.name: Kawaii
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Tiny and bright, with a fast cute vibrato and an octave up.

presets.name: Demon
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: A giant low voice an octave down, with a slow growl, in a cave.

presets.name: Lullaby
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Slow, soft and round: a gentle five-note melody and long last notes.

presets.name: Rap
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Clipped and rhythmic, nearly one note, doubled every line.

presets.name: Cover song
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: For singing a real song over its music: she sings the notes you sing, in your key, bright and doubled like a pop lead.

presets.name: Angel
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Airy and high, with a soft octave above and a cathedral around her.

presets.name: Vaporwave
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Warm, washed-out and dreamy: dark, chorused, a little lo-fi, a slow lazy vibrato.

presets.name: Horror
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: A breathy, haunted voice with a slow wobble, a low shadow and a cold metallic edge.
